response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_group AS (SELECT p.avg_fill_size, p.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS first_margin FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size, AVG(f.first_margin) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark, AVG(f.avg_fill_size - s.benchmark) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark FROM first_group AS f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS s WHERE f.avg_fill_size > s.benchmark;
